text: dsh-mobile 是面向 DSH Web 的移动端适配插件，通过 DSH 客户端插件接入窄屏布局，并依赖 layout 服务同步侧栏和详情面板状态。它在 768 像素以下将展开的侧栏改为覆盖式抽屉并提供遮罩，避免挤压会话内容；将详情面板作为右侧浮层；调整输入栏模型选择器和按钮的窄屏排布，扩大触控区域；把设置对话框改为纵向布局和横向滚动标签，并在用户操作前避免手机输入框自动弹出键盘。样式只针对窄屏生效，适合在手机浏览器上使用 DSH Web。安装到 Web profile 后重启 DSH Web；不需要额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-mobile adapts DSH Web for phones. Below 768 pixels it overlays the sidebar and details panel, adjusts the composer and settings dialog, enlarges touch targets, and delays automatic composer focus until interaction. Install it in a Web profile; no API key or account is needed.
想在手机浏览器里用 DSH Web，侧栏展开时别把聊天区域挤得太窄。
能不能让手机上的 DSH 侧边栏像抽屉一样盖在内容上？
希望在窄屏打开工具详情时，不要压缩会话内容。
让手机上的输入栏按钮和模型选择器排得下，不要互相遮挡。
DSH 的设置弹窗在手机上太窄，能改成上下布局吗？
手机点发送和模式按钮不方便，想让它们更容易触控。
How can I use the DSH web shell on a phone without the sidebar squeezing the conversation?
Can the settings dialog and composer fit better on a narrow mobile screen?
dsh-mobile 的「侧栏抽屉」功能：在 768 像素以下将展开的侧栏浮在主内容上并显示遮罩，点击侧栏以外区域可关闭抽屉。
dsh-mobile 的「详情面板浮层」功能：在窄屏把详情面板固定到屏幕右侧显示，避免它挤占会话主区域。
dsh-mobile 的「输入栏适配」功能：在手机宽度下约束模型选择器宽度并截断过长标签，让模式、模型和发送控件保持在同一行。
dsh-mobile 的「设置弹窗适配」功能：在窄屏将设置对话框改为纵向布局，并把导航标签排成可横向滚动的一行。
dsh-mobile 的「移动端焦点处理」功能：在窄屏用户首次操作前模糊自动聚焦的输入框，避免页面载入时立即弹出手机键盘。

@tecfancy/dsh-mobile README · dsh-mobile：**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

**A mobile adapter for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web shell.** The stock
shell is desktop-first: below 1024px the sidebar only collapses to a rail, and
on phones the expanded drawer squeezes the main column to ~110px, composer
buttons overlap, and the settings dialog shrinks to a sliver. `dsh-mobile`
adds the missing phone tier (< 768px) as a client plugin — no shell fork, no
desktop changes.

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tecfancy/dsh-mobile)
[](LICENSE)

@tecfancy/dsh-mobile README · Features：- **Overlay sidebar drawer** — opening the sidebar on a phone floats it over
  the content with a scrim instead of squeezing the main column to 110px;
  tapping outside closes it.
- **Overlay details panel** — the tool-details panel opens as a right-side
  overlay and never squeezes the conversation.
- **Non-overlapping composer** — the mode buttons and the model selector wrap
  onto separate rows instead of covering each other.
- **Re-flowed settings dialog** — the dialog stacks vertically with a
  horizontally scrollable tab bar; the content column gets full width.
- **Zero desktop regression** — every rule hangs under a narrow-viewport
  marker; viewports ≥ 1024px behave exactly like the stock shell.

@tecfancy/dsh-mobile README · Install：Requires Node ≥ 22 and a DSH installation (`dsh` CLI). Install into your
profile and restart `dsh web`:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @tecfancy/dsh-mobile

@tecfancy/dsh-mobile README · restart: dsh web：```

> Note: if your npm registry is a mirror (e.g. `registry.npmmirror.com`),
> brand-new packages can lag behind the official registry for a while —
> add `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` if the install reports 404.

The plugin activates automatically on narrow viewports (< 768px) and stays
inert on desktop. Removing it is one command: `dsh plugin --profile web remove
@tecfancy/dsh-mobile`.

@tecfancy/dsh-mobile README · How it works：- A JS breakpoint layer marks narrow viewports as `body[data-dsh-mobile]`.
- A state bridge mirrors the shell's layout state onto `body[data-dsh-drawer]`
  / `body[data-dsh-details]`.
- A stylesheet (anchored on the shell's stable `[data-slot]` hooks) turns the
  sidebar/details columns into fixed overlays on phones, re-flows the
  composer and the settings dialog, and never runs outside the mobile tier.

@tecfancy/dsh-mobile README · How it works：No shell source is modified, no server component is required, and the plugin
coexists with other shell-level plugins (verified with `dsh-better-sidebar`).

@tecfancy/dsh-mobile README · Compatibility：- DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` (tested on macOS and Ubuntu 24.04; full viewport matrix:
  360 / 390 / 430 / 768 / 1440).
- The 768–1023px tablet range keeps the stock shell behavior (by design).
- `prefers-reduced-motion` is honored.
